assertions.notes: As kody (admin, acme, read:reservation_report:any, master flag on) the report builder at /acme/reports/new does NOT offer the bookings or waitlist_entries subjects, while the minted reports token for the same user does list both. Cause (read from code, not fixed): all three App report routes filter the catalog with only the staffing grant set - apps/app/app/routes/_app+/$orgSlug_+/reports+/new.tsx:35, _index.tsx:38 and $reportId.tsx:48 all call catalogForGrants(fullCatalog, staff.subjects) where staff comes from resolveStaffReportAccessForRequest; the reservations subjects are granted by resolveReservationsReportAccess (used for the token) and never added to that set, so catalogForGrants drops them (packages/reports/src/access.ts:44-48 isGatedSubject).
assertions.limitations: Only the positive half of the assertion was tested (kody sees the subjects). The second half (Report-less operator token without the subjects, builder not offering them) is owned by the VAL-REPORT-002/020 gating group; I did not create a restricted account.
